10-Year-Old Dies After Being Made to Stand in Sun at Delhi School

A 10-year-old girl in Delhi died after allegedly being made to stand in the sun for not bringing her book to school. The incident occurred at a school where the student was reportedly punished by a teacher. Following the child's death, the teacher involved has been transferred. The exact circumstances and duration of the punishment are central to the ongoing discussion.
